acceptances.reason: GHSA-jmr9-qjv8-65gv and GHSA-7pqw-9j4j-h8q3 in extract-zip: symlink path traversal / arbitrary file writes when unpacking an archive. Reached only through the Lighthouse and size-limit toolchain, which uses it to unpack a Chrome build downloaded from Google over TLS during a performance run. No archive here is attacker-supplied, and none of these packages ship in the application bundle. Upstream has no patched release (extract-zip latest is 2.0.1, range <=2.0.1), and the only fix npm proposes is a semver-major change of @lhci/cli, which would take the performance gate below the version its evidence format depends on. Re-review when extract-zip publishes a fix or @puppeteer/browsers drops it. Re-fingerprinted (RIN-892, 2026-11-05): npm audit now reports the chain as via [@lhci/utils, lighthouse], so the hash moved; same lockfile, same advisories, same dev-only exposure.
